text:
Predicates:
StartsWith(x, y) ::: x starts with the number y.
From(x, y) ::: x is from location y.
JoesPlate(x) ::: x is Joe's vehicle registration plate.
TomsPlate(x) ::: x is Tom's license plate.
Premises:
∀x (StartsWith(x, 34) → From(x, Istanbul)) ::: All vehicle registration plates in Istanbul begin with the number 34.
∀x (¬StartsWith(x, 34) → ¬From(x, Istanbul)) ::: Plates that do not begin with the number 34 are not from Istanbul.
From(JoesPlate, Istanbul) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
StartsWith(TomsPlate, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with the number 35.
StartsWith(TomsPlate, 35) → ¬StartsWith(TomsPlate, 34) ::: If a license plate begins with the number 35, then it does not begin with the number 34.
Conclusion:
From(TomsPlate, Istanbul) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
